### Functions for handling invalid data
```{python}
#Make adjustments to account for missing data
def adjust_missing(df):
    df_adj = df.copy()

    #Handle missing ethnic category data
    df_adj.fillna({"patient_ethniccat":"X"}, inplace=True)

    return df_adj
```

### Functions for deriving features
```{python}
#Function to derive new features in the data
def derive_features(df):
    #Sickness Rate
    df["sickness_rate"] = (
    df["sick_days_lost"] / df["sick_days_available"])
    df.drop(
        ["sick_days_lost", "sick_days_available"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    #Vacancy Rate
    df["vacancy_rate"] = (
        df["vac_vacancy"] 
        / (df["vac_sub_sip"] + df["vac_vacancy"])
    )
    df.drop(
        ["vac_vacancy", "vac_sub_sip"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    #Occupancy Rate
    df["occupancy_rate"] = (
        df["site_beds_occupied"] / df["site_beds_open"])
    df.drop(
        ["site_beds_occupied", "site_beds_open"], axis=1, inplace=True)

    return df
```

### Function to handle the preprocessing application
```{python}
def preprocessing(
    df, target="los", test_size=0.2, exclude=[], cat_columns=[], rs=0
    ):

    #Split data into target and features
    features = list(df.columns)
    features.remove(target)

    X = df[features]
    y = df[target]

    #Stratify the split data
    ##Currently based on whether the target is 0 or non-0
    stratify_mask = np.where(df.copy()[[target]] == 0, 0, 1)

    #Apply test train split
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, 
        random_state=rs,  
        test_size=test_size, 
        shuffle=True)
        #stratify=stratify_mask)

    #Adjust for missing data
    X_train = adjust_missing(X_train)
    #Derive new features
    X_train = derive_features(X_train)

    #Adjust for missing data
    X_test = adjust_missing(X_test)
    #Derive new features
    X_test = derive_features(X_test)

    #Build encoding preprocessor
    config_custom = {}
    df_catenc = cat_enc.format_cat_features(
        X_train.drop(exclude, axis=1), 
        config_custom, 
        train=True)

    preprocessor = cat_enc.get_encoding_fit(df_catenc, categorical_columns)

    #Apply fit to train and test
    X_train = cat_enc.apply_fit(X_train, preprocessor)
    X_test = cat_enc.apply_fit(X_test, preprocessor)
    
    return X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test
```

### Code to execute the preprocessing
```{python}
#List of columns to exclude
exclude = ([
    "patient_gender", 
    "patient_ethniccat", 
    "date_year"
])

#List all features that are categorical
categorical_columns = ([
    "provider_code", 
    "site_code", 
    "admission_dayofweek",
    "pod_intended",
    "admission_method", 
    "admission_source", 
    "date_month"
    ])

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = preprocessing(
    df_base, 
    exclude=exclude, 
    cat_columns=categorical_columns,
    rs=2)
```

### Fit the model
```{python}
model = LinearRegression()

model.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.scatter(y_test, y_pred, alpha=0.5)
plt.plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()], [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], 'r--')  # 45-degree line
plt.xlabel("Actual")
plt.ylabel("Predicted")
plt.title("Actual vs Predicted")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
residuals = y_test - y_pred
plt.scatter(y_pred, residuals, alpha=0.5)
plt.axhline(0, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel("Predicted")
plt.ylabel("Residuals")
plt.title("Residual Plot")
plt.show()
```

```{python}

```
